Hearing your husband talking to someone else in a way that makes you uncomfortable can be incredibly distressing and confusing. Before approaching him, it can be helpful to take a few deep breaths and gather your thoughts so you can enter the conversation as calmly as possible. Choose a quiet, private moment when neither of you is distracted or rushing. 

When you bring it up, try using "I" statements to express your feelings without sounding immediately accusatory, which can often make people defensive. You might say something like, "I heard you talking on the phone earlier, and it made me feel anxious. Can we talk about who you were speaking with?" Listen carefully to his response and trust your instincts. If this conversation leads to a larger conflict or uncovers deeper trust issues in your marriage, reaching out to a couples counselor or an individual therapist can provide a safe, neutral space to navigate these difficult emotions.
